profile.headline: Lead - Implementation at eQ Technologic
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned Application Developer, Software Architect, and Database Administrator with over 25 years of experience delivering robust, scalable solutions across a wide range of technologies and industries.

Core Specialties:
Blazor, WebAPI, WCF, ASP.NET (2.0 through 9), MVC, jQuery, Bootstrap, Application Design, Agile/SCRUM methodologies, Product Lifecycle Maintenance, and SQL Server (2005–2022) design and development. I also bring deep expertise in XML/XSLT, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and pure HTML-based reporting.

In my spare time, I enjoy building and enhancing a league practice and score-tracking system using Blazor, FluentUI, and CosmosDB—combining my passion for software craftsmanship with real-world utility.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
As Emdeon's Pharmacy Services Software Engineer/Team Lead for the Messaging Team, my responsibilities are to assist in the design, development, and management of all electronic messaging products.  

These responsibilities include resource planning, development analysis, software design and code reviews and delegation of tasks among my team.

Key Accomplishments:
- Designed new "Single Point of Entry" service so our customers can send varying formatted messages and the service will perform the following.  a) authenticate sender b) analyze incoming message b) route message to the correct service/destination within our network thus removing the requirement from the customer to re-code/test/deploy when new message formats and standards change.

Other responsibilities:
-  Act as a liaison between my team and other departments (Quality Assurance, Web Development, Product Management, Project Management, Systems, and the Executives).

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Designs and develops multi-tier database applications utilizing the latest Microsoft Technologies including .NET Framework (2.0, 3.0 and 3.5), AJAX and LINQ.

Successfully converted the existing ASP.NET 2.0 Framework application to utilize WCF, LINQ and .NET Framework 3.0 & 3.5.

Successfully converted the legacy ASP.NET application from the 1.1 framework to the 2.0 Framework and incorporated AJAX for a better end user experience.

Successfully designed and executed the migration plan to move our SQL Database from SQL Server 2005 to 64 Bit SQL 2008 on Server 2008x64

Extensive experience in database connectivity using C#, .NET and ASP.NET and LINQ.

Improved existing Database performance by taking advantage of new technologies in Microsoft SQL Server 2008.

Extensive experience in Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

Extensive experience in XML Web services using C#, .NET and ASP.NET.

Extensive experience in Windows Services that interact with SQL Server databases as well as SMTP mail server and Sybase (SQL Anywhere).

Incorporated and customized 3rd party web user controls to enhance User Interface and functionality.

Reduced the increasing dependence on Microsoft Access by developing new modules in the existing web application to be more scalable and maintainable.

Provide continual performance monitoring of all databases to ensure optimal efficiency and made necessary adjustments to either the structure of the database or the query being executed to improve overall performance and end user experience.

positions.title: Production Controller
positions.description:
Generated custom Web based reports for eMOC to provide real-time visibility to vital information to commanders and production supervisors.

Customized multiple Aircraft Status reports using the required and highly limited Web Based Custom Report generator that is currently being utilized at 3 Air Force Bases throughout the country.

Administers Wing level web based Aircraft Maintenance Status system (eMOC)

Maintains and updates status information for all aircraft using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint used in daily briefings with Commanders and Supervisors.

Automated many tasks in Excel for meeting presentations, and data entry.  No longer do we need to change data in 3 or 4 screens to accomplish one task.

Maintenance for F-16C Falcon.

Monitored and maintained all aspects of maintenance using CAMS (Computer Automated Maintenance System).

Supervise subordinates in various maintenance tasks.

Currently holds active security clearance.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Closely work with new software development team to migrate existing software to utilize latest .NET Framework and other Microsoft technologies.

Successfully converted existing Web Service from the 1.1 Framework to the 2.0 framework.

Currently working on converting the web service from the 2.0 Framework to WCF and 3.5 Framework incorporating LINQ to SQL.

Assist CEO in Sales presentations
